admin-2026008197.hook_line: 마약류 취급내역을 기한 내 보고하지 못해 업무정지 3일
admin-2026008197.summary: 식약처가 (주)휴온스에 마약류제조업자 업무정지 3일을 처분했다. 마약류를 양수·제조·판매하면서 취급내역을 보고기한과 변경 보고기한 안에 보고하지 못했다.
key_facts: 위반: 마약류 양수·제조·판매 취급내역을 보고기한·변경 보고기한 내 보고하지 않음
처분: 마약류제조업자 업무정지 3일(2026-11-23~25)
근거: 마약류 관리에 관한 법률 제11조, 같은 법 시행규칙 제21조
admin-2026008197.implication: 미보고 품목에는 Zopiclone R-Isomer 표준품, 펜터민염산염 원료, 케타민염산염 주사제가 있었다.
checks: 마약류 양수·제조·판매 건마다 보고기한 안에 보고됐는지 대조하는가?
변경 보고가 필요한 취급내역도 기한 관리 대상에 들어 있는가?

en.hook_line: Narcotics handling records not reported on time, 3-day business suspension
en.summary: MFDS imposed a 3-day business suspension on a narcotics manufacturer after it failed to report narcotics acquisition, manufacturing and sales records within the reporting and amendment deadlines.
key_facts: Violation: narcotics acquisition, manufacturing and sales records not reported within the reporting and amendment deadlines
Sanction: 3-day suspension of narcotics manufacturing business (2026-11-23 to 25)
Basis: Narcotics Control Act Article 11 and Enforcement Rule Article 21
en.implication: Unreported items included a Zopiclone R-Isomer reference standard, phentermine hydrochloride raw material and a ketamine hydrochloride injection.
checks: Is each narcotics acquisition, manufacture and sale checked against its reporting deadline?
Are records that need amendment reports also tracked against deadlines?

gmpinspect-1Q73JiEyrIf.hook_line: 시험실과 시설장비 분야에서 기타 등급 지적 3건
gmpinspect-1Q73JiEyrIf.summary: 식약처가 이탈리아 완제의약품 제조소 ABIOGEN PHARMA S.p.A를 사후 실사해 지적(보완)사항 3건을 냈다.
key_facts: 지적 1: 시험실 — 배지 관리 상황을 적절히 기록할 것(기타)
지적 2: 시험실 — 시험 판정의 데이터 완전성 보완 대책을 마련할 것(기타)
지적 3: 시설장비 — 제조설비 운전 적격성평가를 적절히 수행할 것(기타)
평가 결과: 지적(보완)사항 있음
checks: 배지의 입고·조제·사용 관리 상황이 기록되는가? (지적 1)
시험 판정 데이터의 완전성을 보증하는 대책이 있는가? (지적 2)
제조설비 운전 적격성평가를 수행하고 기록했는가? (지적 3)

en.hook_line: Three findings rated other in the laboratory and facilities and equipment areas
en.summary: MFDS conducted a post-approval inspection of ABIOGEN PHARMA S.p.A, a finished product site in Italy, and issued 3 findings.
key_facts: Finding 1: laboratory — record the status of culture media management properly (other)
Finding 2: laboratory — put in place data integrity measures for test decisions (other)
Finding 3: facilities and equipment — perform operational qualification of manufacturing equipment properly (other)
Outcome: deficiencies identified
checks: Is the receipt, preparation and use of culture media recorded? (Finding 1)
Are there measures assuring data integrity of test decisions? (Finding 2)
Was operational qualification of manufacturing equipment performed and documented? (Finding 3)

fda483-196287.hook_line: 안정성 함량 기준일탈 조사가 340일째 열려 있었음
fda483-196287.summary: FDA가 Water-Jel Technologies, LLC에 Form 483(관찰사항 2건)을 발행했다. 안정성 기준일탈(OOS)·부적합 조사 지연과 안정성 시험 프로그램 미준수를 지적했다.
key_facts: 관찰 1: 일반의약품 안정성 기준일탈 조사가 340일, 290일, 163일 등 열려 있었고 부적합 조사의 50% 초과가 156~681일째 열려 있음
관찰 2: 회사 표준작업절차서(SOP) 5.9절과 달리 제품별 안정성 시험 계획서(보관 조건·기간·시험 간격·검체 수)를 수립하지 않음
fda483-196287.implication: 1년 이상 열려 있는 부적합 조사에는 포장 오류, 수량 부족, 누출, 잘못된 품목 인쇄 건이 있었다(관찰 1).
checks: 안정성 기준일탈 조사의 종결 기한이 정해져 있고 지연 사유를 기록하는가? (관찰 1)
제품마다 보관 조건과 시험 간격을 정한 안정성 시험 계획서가 있는가? (관찰 2)

en.hook_line: A stability potency OOS investigation had been open for 340 days
en.summary: FDA issued a Form 483 with 2 observations to Water-Jel Technologies, LLC, citing delayed stability OOS and non-conformance investigations and failure to follow the written stability program.
key_facts: Observation 1: OTC stability OOS investigations open for 340, 290 and 163 days, among others, and more than 50% of non-conformances open for 156-681 days
Observation 2: contrary to section 5.9 of the firm's SOP, no product-specific stability protocol stating storage conditions, study length, test intervals and number of samples
en.implication: Non-conformances open for a year or more included packaging errors, short counts, leaking product and a wrong item printed (Observation 1).
checks: Do stability OOS investigations have closure deadlines and documented reasons for delay? (Observation 1)
Does every product have a stability protocol defining storage conditions and test intervals? (Observation 2)

00ae76e635bb.hook_line: 기록 제출 요청을 거부했고 전 제품이 수입경보 66-79에 등재됨
00ae76e635bb.summary: FDA가 중국 원료의약품(API) 제조소 Tianjin Healthcare Medical Technology Co., Ltd.에 경고서한을 발행했다. FDA의 기록 요청에 응하지 않은 것을 위반으로 지적했다.
key_facts: 위반 1: FD&C Act 704(a)(4)에 따른 기록 요청을 거부함(301(e) 금지 행위)
회신과 FDA 판단: 회사는 2026-06-24 미국용 제품 생산을 중단하겠다며 기록 제출을 거부했고, FDA는 생산 중단이 규제 의무를 소급해 면제하지 않는다고 판단함
당국 조치: 2026-08-25 회사 의약품 전체를 수입경보 66-79에 등재함
00ae76e635bb.implication: 수입 기록에서 이 회사를 제조원으로 신고한 약국 조제용 원료의약품이 미국에 여러 차례 들어온 사실이 확인됐다. FDA는 2026-06-25 회사 원료의약품이 미국에 수입돼 아직 유효기간 안에 있다며 다시 요청했으나 회사는 거부했다. FDA는 미국 시장용 생산을 그만두려면 21 CFR 207.29(a)(3)에 따라 중단 후 30일 안에 등록을 갱신해야 한다고 적었다.
checks: FDA 기록 요청을 받으면 회신 기한과 담당자가 정해져 있는가? (위반 1)
미국 공급을 중단한 제품의 등록과 품목 목록을 갱신했는가? (위반 1)

en.title_issue: Records refused, placed on import alert
en.hook_line: The firm refused FDA records requests and all its drugs were placed on Import Alert 66-79
en.summary: FDA issued a warning letter to Tianjin Healthcare Medical Technology Co., Ltd., an API manufacturer in China, for refusing to provide records requested by FDA.
key_facts: Violation 1: refused a records request under FD&C Act 704(a)(4), a prohibited act under 301(e)

Response and FDA's assessment: on 2026-06-24 the firm said it would discontinue the products for the U.S. and refused to provide records; FDA said ceasing production does not retroactively relieve regulatory obligations
Agency action: all drugs from the firm placed on Import Alert 66-79 on 2026-08-25
en.implication: Import records showed multiple shipments of APIs for pharmacy compounding that declared the firm as manufacturer. On 2026-06-25 FDA repeated the request because the APIs imported to the U.S. were still within expiry, and the firm again refused. FDA stated that under 21 CFR 207.29(a)(3) an establishment must update its registration within 30 calendar days of ceasing operations.
checks: Is there a defined owner and response deadline for FDA records requests? (Violation 1)
Have registration and listings been updated for products no longer supplied to the U.S.? (Violation 1)

2026-23005.summary: FDA가 승인된 항암 치료제와 함께 쓰는 면역조직화학 검사 시스템을 Class III(PMA)에서 Class II(특별 관리, 510(k) 대상)로 재분류하는 안을 제안했다.
key_facts: 바뀌는 것: 면역조직화학 검사 시스템을 Class III(PMA)에서 Class II(특별 관리)로 재분류하고 510(k) 대상으로 함
적용 대상: 제품 코드 MVC, NKF, QQT, NQF, PLS, PKW, QUL, QNH, QZJ, SBL, SER, SHF
2026-23005.implication: FDA는 기존 분류 규정을 일부 고치고 새 기기 분류 규정과 특별 관리 사항도 함께 제안했다.
quotes_translation: FDA는 승인된 항암 치료제와 함께 쓰도록 표시된 면역조직화학(IHC) 검사 시스템(제품 코드 MVC, NKF, QQT, NQF, PLS, PKW, QUL, QNH, QZJ, SBL, SE…)의 재분류를 제안한다.

en.summary: FDA proposed to reclassify immunohistochemistry test systems for use with a corresponding approved oncology therapeutic product from Class III (PMA) to Class II (special controls), subject to 510(k).
key_facts: What changes: immunohistochemistry test systems move from Class III (PMA) to Class II (special controls), subject to 510(k)
Applies to: product codes MVC, NKF, QQT, NQF, PLS, PKW, QUL, QNH, QZJ, SBL, SER and SHF
en.implication: FDA also proposed minor revisions to an existing classification regulation and a new device classification regulation with special controls.

admin-2026008055.summary: 식약처가 비오신코리아(주)에 셀레나제티프로주사 판매업무정지 10일을 처분했다. 2026년 1분기 이 품목의 공급내역을 기한 안에 보고하지 않았다.

checks: 완제의약품 출하일에 공급내역 보고가 함께 이뤄지는가?
분기마다 출하일과 공급내역 보고일을 대조하는가?

en.title_issue: Supply records not reported on time
en.hook_line: Supply records reported late, 10-day sales suspension for the product
en.summary: MFDS imposed a 10-day sales suspension on a supplier for one injection product after it failed to report the product's supply records for the first quarter of 2026 on time.
key_facts: Violation: supply records for a finished injection product not reported on time at shipment
Timeline: shipped 2026-02-11, reported 2026-02-13
Sanction: 10-day sales suspension for the product (2026-11-24 to 2026-12-03)
Basis: Pharmaceutical Affairs Act Article 47-3(2) and Enforcement Rule Article 45
en.implication: The sanction was reduced under general criterion 12 because the supply records were reported within 1 month after the deadline.
checks: Are supply records reported on the day finished products are shipped?
Are shipment dates reconciled with supply report dates each quarter?

admin-2026008195.hook_line: 향정신성의약품 표준품 등 취급내역을 기한 내 보고하지 않아 경고
admin-2026008195.summary: 식약처가 대한약품공업(주)에 마약류제조업자 경고를 처분했다. 향정신성의약품 프로포폴 표준품 등 116건의 취급내역을 보고기한 내 보고하지 않았다.
key_facts: 위반: 향정신성의약품 프로포폴 표준품(100 mg) 등 116건의 취급내역을 보고기한 내 보고하지 않음
처분: 마약류제조업자 경고
근거: 마약류 관리에 관한 법률 제11조, 같은 법 시행규칙 제21조
checks: 시험용 표준품 같은 마약류의 취급내역도 보고 대상으로 관리하는가?
보고기한을 넘긴 마약류 취급내역이 있는지 정기적으로 확인하는가?

en.hook_line: Psychotropic handling records not reported on time, warning issued
en.summary: MFDS issued a warning to a narcotics manufacturer that did not report 116 psychotropic drug handling records, including a propofol reference standard, within the deadline.
key_facts: Violation: 116 handling records for psychotropic drugs, including a propofol reference standard (100 mg), not reported within the deadline
Sanction: warning to the narcotics manufacturer
Basis: Narcotics Control Act Article 11 and Enforcement Rule Article 21
checks: Are handling records for reference standards that are narcotics managed as reportable?

en.hook_line: Handling records reported late across raw material use, manufacturing and import-export
en.summary: MFDS issued a warning to a company registered as a narcotics raw material user, manufacturer and importer-exporter after it failed to report narcotics handling records within the reporting and amendment deadlines.
key_facts: Violation: narcotics raw material use, purchase and manufacturing, and acquisition and sales records not reported within the reporting and amendment deadlines
Sanction: warning as narcotics raw material user, manufacturer and importer-exporter
Basis: Narcotics Control Act Article 11 and Enforcement Rule Article 21
en.implication: Unreported items included dihydrocodeine tartrate, dextromethorphan hydrobromide hydrate, etizolam and a clonazepam tablet product.
checks: Is a reporting owner and deadline set for each narcotics business category?
Is the reporting deadline recorded each time imported narcotic raw material is used?
